description: Poor: no branding greeting/closing, no verification, no paraphrase, curt and unhelpful tone, but eventually resolves and does not refuse a supervisor (no auto-fail).
transcript:
[00:00] Client: My TV package channels are all missing.
[00:04] Agent: Yeah? Have you tried restarting the box.
[00:08] Client: Not yet.
[00:10] Agent: Do that.
[00:30] Client: Okay it's restarting... the channels are back now.
[00:36] Agent: Good.
[00:38] Client: Was there something causing it?
[00:41] Agent: Just do a restart if it happens again.
[00:45] Client: Alright.
[00:47] Agent: Anything else or are we done.
[00:50] Client: No, that's all.
[00:52] Agent: Okay bye.
